lines.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

data.define: Used when your progress is lost and you must restart.

example.text: Plan failed. Back to square one.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back to square one' after small progress.
misuse.why: It means you lost all progress.

data.l1: retour à la case départ; repartir de zéro
data.l1_hook: Le plan a échoué. Et maintenant ? « back to square one ».
data.l1_ex: Le plan a échoué. "Back to square one".

native.tip: “back to square one” = retour à la case départ; repartir de zéro. Exemple: “Plan failed. Back to square one.”
